title: Laguna S 2.1: price, context window and specs
answer: Laguna S 2.1 is a model in Poolside's Poolside Laguna family, first listed on 2026-07-21. It takes text in and returns text, with a context window of 1.0 million tokens and up to 131K tokens of output. On the lowest-cost route in the OpenRouter catalog it costs $0.09 per million input tokens and $0.18 per million output tokens. It supports a reasoning mode, where the model works through a problem before it answers. Its weights are published on Hugging Face as poolside/Laguna-S-2.1, so it can be run on your own hardware as well as through a provider.
